files.why: The only production file in scope. formatCitation has three wrong fallback returns (as of today: line 32 Dynamous-empty-lesson_url, line 46 unparseable video_url, line 53 video_url without a v param). Lines 46 and 53 drop both the '- ' list marker and the snippet blockquote; line 32 keeps the snippet but lacks the '- ' marker. The two valid returns (lines 35 and 58) show the target shape: '- [Title](url) — <range>' followed by the continuation line '  > "<snippet>"'. Lines 43-45 and 50-52 are byte-identical duplicated console.warn+return exits.

The suite that must keep passing and gains the red-first acceptance tests. Its current fallback cases assert only substrings the buggy output already contains, which is why the suite is green today; it also pins the console.warn payload byte-identically and pins the two valid-path shapes.

Defines the Citation interface (lines 46-79) the seam consumes: snippet: string; video_url: string; start_seconds/end_seconds: number; source_type?: 'youtube' | 'dynamous' | string; lesson_url?: string. Unchanged by this fix.

Sole production caller: imports exportConversationAsMarkdown (line 9) behind the export-conversation action. Confirms no component changes are needed; Message.tsx imports a different formatTimestamp from CitationModal and does not touch this module.

Line 42 ('Every cited chunk shows: video title, link to the video, exact-timestamp deep-link, and the quoted transcript snippet') is the product requirement the export currently violates; line 50 makes markdown export an in-scope capability; 'Citation UX' is an allowed evolution.

invariants.name: File envelope
invariants.why: Only app/frontend/src/lib/exportMarkdown.ts changes among production files; test changes are confined to app/frontend/src/lib/exportMarkdown.test.ts. Backend, components (CitationModal/Message/ChatArea/Sidebar), and hooks are out of scope.

invariants.name: Byte-identical console.warn payload
invariants.why: Both YouTube fallback triggers must still warn exactly '[exportMarkdown] Skipping timestamp link — invalid video_url: "<video_url>"' (em dash U+2014 inside the message); existing tests assert it verbatim.

invariants.name: Unicode separators preserved
invariants.why: Em dash '—' (U+2014) between title/link and the range; en dash '–' (U+2013) inside ranges such as '0:10–0:20'. Both are asserted by existing tests.

invariants.name: Empty-snippet guard unchanged
invariants.why: formatCitation still returns '' when snippet is absent, empty, or whitespace-only — pinned by an existing test.

invariants.name: Valid-path shapes frozen
invariants.why: YouTube with a v param and Dynamous with a lesson_url keep returning '- [Title](url) — <range>' plus the continuation line '  > "<snippet>"'; formatTimestamp, the export header, and the filename slug are untouched.

invariants.name: Fix lives inside formatCitation, not its callers
invariants.why: formatSources joins entries with '\n' only, so the '- ' marker and the blockquote must be emitted by formatCitation itself; patching at the caller is explicitly forbidden and would leave direct formatCitation callers broken.

invariants.name: No dependency or manifest changes
invariants.why: No new or version-changed packages; the fix is pure string shaping in one lib module (frontend-lib has allowed_imports: []).

invariants.name: Red-first acceptance tests
invariants.why: The new AC cases must fail on the unchanged tree by asserting exactly what the buggy fallback lacks — the '> "<snippet>"' blockquote and/or the leading '- ' marker — since the current suite is green.
